prerequisites: Parent confirms previous possible window cleanup
Explicit parent release of new make
limitations: Installed Arc.sdef documents app-level write-only tabs, but runtime support/ID resolution is unproven.
UUID capture itself can fail; boolean-owned reference still gets one close attempt. Unknown cleanup blocks any further make.
Close acknowledgement and no-longer-resolvable ID are separate API observations,not proof of physical window absence.
No viewport/zoom/screenshot compatibility is established by this route.
ownershipCapture: Immediately after make: log only the returned descriptor to a private0600 stderr file with osascript source-form rendering before any id property lookup. Driver exposes only typed tab/window UUID metadata; no existing enumeration. Runtime serializer support remains unproven.
ownedReferenceReadiness: After private descriptor capture,retries only that returned own reference on-1728 for at most40x250ms. No additional make or personal-tab/window lookup. Asynchronous registration is a hypothesis,not the established cause of the first failure.
